_doc: Package WP2 (docs/14-m4-plan.md §2.6): a fork's cost in live-tick equivalents per map. A search forks the live game once (ctx.fork(), a structural clone at AgentHost's default forkMode: a take of the live game's state and a clone), takes that fork's state (GameFork.source()) and clones it for each rollout (ForkSource.fork()). first: the first rollout's fork (ctx.fork(), the take and its clone); each: every other rollout's clone. Measured in situ: the median over a map's searches of the fork's wall ms over the base rollout's ms per tick (a rollout step is a live tick's work: the game's tick and the policy copy's think), from the searches' own search-rows (forkMs, simMs, h). Maps not listed cost the fallback (about the 90th percentile of the measured maps).
measured: 2026-09-27 at 84ae424 (clone ctx.fork): in situ, the S1 screen's searches (quick@20 games 0-13, /tmp/claude-0/m4-screen/s1-84ae424; /tmp/claude-0/pkg-WP2/r2/phi_insitu.py); Giant World Map and North America from the fork bench at 8de76f2 (/tmp/claude-0/pkg-WP2/r2/phi-head.jsonl: ctx.fork() + take + clone, and a clone), whose repeated forks under load run up to 2x the in-situ cost
